verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party pages say Migration Assistant makes setting up a new Mac quick and easy even when migrating from Windows, and the Mac User Guide has a switcher section on transferring files from a PC. Setup Assistant also brings over Wi-Fi and Apple Account sign-in from a nearby iPhone. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that settings (not just files) are migrated, in-depth detail on what Migration Assistant transfers and how, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
